items.cv_ref: 学生工作与社会实践/课程助教
items.num_check_reason: summary: zh gives course terms as YYYY.MM ranges, en uses month names

summary.en: Courses: Introduction to Computing (Sep–Dec 2023) and Data Structures and Algorithms (Sep–Dec 2024).

bullets.en: Assisted instructors with office hours, homework grading, and lab guidance to keep the course running smoothly.
bullets.zh: 协助任课教师开展课程答疑、作业批改与实验指导，保障课程有序运行。

bullets.en: Maintained the course lab environment and reviewed grading rules, and helped instructors compile end-of-term assessment materials.
bullets.zh: 参与课程实验环境维护与评测规则核查，配合教师完成学期考核材料整理。

items.cv_ref: 学生工作与社会实践/学生会技术部部长

role.en: Head of Technology Department, Student Union

bullets.en: Managed the department's day-to-day operations and trained new members, supporting the college's student-affairs work.
bullets.zh: 承担部门日常事务管理与新成员培养，配合学院完成各项学生工作部署。

bullets.en: Co-organized technical workshops on Git, Bash, and Vim, and provided technical and equipment support for student events.
bullets.zh: 参与组织 Git、Bash、Vim 等技术分享会，保障学生活动技术支持与设备运行。
